# OpenJoystickDriver

> Expanded LLM context for the macOS userspace gamepad driver. Prefer `llms.txt` when a short index is enough.

The signed app owns the runtime, virtual HID, and authenticated local CLI. Physical HID and virtual HID use IOKit (`IOHIDManager`/`IOHIDDevice` and `IOHIDUserDevice`) on every supported macOS (12+). Raw USB uses app-side IOUSBHost, or the `XboxUSB` personality of the `com.openjoystickdriver.VirtualHIDDevice` DriverKit extension for Apple-entitled Microsoft GIP interfaces.

`OpenJoystickDriverKit` owns parsers, records, HID/USB ports, and policy. It must not import SwifterKit. `OpenJoystickDriverUSB` and `DriverKitGenerator` are the SwifterKit boundaries. `OpenJoystickDriver` composes the app, CLI, and adapters.

Do not edit `Sources/OpenJoystickDriverKit/Resources/Controllers/` or `.build/driverkit/generated/`. Catalog write: `./Scripts/ojd catalog regenerate --write`. DriverKit: `./Scripts/ojd driverkit generate`. Controller JSON uses decimal numbers. Support status lives in `docs/connecting-controllers/supported-controllers.md`; do not duplicate it here.

Production and development USBDriverKit personalities match only Apple's approved Microsoft GIP pairs: `045E:02D1`, `045E:02DD`, `045E:02E3`, `045E:02EA`, `045E:0B00`, `045E:0B0A`, `045E:0B12`. Accessible third-party GIP devices such as GameSir G7 SE `3537:1010` stay on direct IOUSBHost. The host user-client allowlist must be exactly `com.openjoystickdriver.VirtualHIDDevice`. `com.apple.developer.hid.virtual.device` belongs only to the app.

Generator inputs are `ControllerSources.lock.json` and `Resources/ControllerOverrides/`. Schemas are in `Resources/Schemas/`. `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` are symlinks to `AGENTS.md`.

```bash
./Scripts/ojd catalog regenerate --check
./Scripts/ojd check profiles
./Scripts/ojd check schemas
just lint
./Scripts/ojd check driverkit
swift test
```

Parser/protocol: `./Scripts/ojd test parsers-macos14`. Cache: `./Scripts/ojd repair swiftpm-module-cache`. Hardware, signing, notarization, and permission behavior need the focused local diagnostics in `contributing/testing/` and `Scripts/README.md`. Unsigned generation does not prove those facts.

- [Short index](llms.txt): curated llms.txt v2 entry point
- [README](README.md): install, compatibility identities, troubleshooting
- [Controllers](docs/connecting-controllers/supported-controllers.md): supported controllers, evidence classes, VID:PID, DEXT scope
- [Permissions](docs/permissions-and-security/permissions.md): Input Monitoring, Accessibility, and related grants
- [Generic HID](docs/connecting-controllers/generic-hid-controllers.md): descriptor-based parsing of uncatalogued HID gamepads
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, adding controllers, code rules
- [Localization](LOCALIZATION.md): GUI and CLI string catalogs
- [Documentation map](docs/README.md): user, testing, and development pages
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): generated-file rules and validation commands
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 history
- [License](LICENSE): MIT
